afd.snippet: 000 FXUS65 KGJT 071755 AFDGJT Area Forecast Discussion National Weather Service Grand Junction CO 1155 AM MDT Mon Sep 7 2026 .KEY MESSAGES... - Expect showers and thunderstorms through Monday morning. Isolated stronger storms may be capable of producing flash flooding. - Warmer and drier conditions return Tuesday onward, though a chance for isolated mountain showers remains each afternoon. && .DIS

fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION... Some isolated showers, maybe a few storms, will be possible over the San Juans and Continental Divide over the coming days. Drier air will continue to move in as temperatures creep up to anywhere from 5 to 10 degrees above more seasonal values. Very spotty critical fire weather conditions show up Wednesday onwards but coverage is minimal. ...GUSTY ERRATIC WINDS CAN BE EXPECTED NEAR
